title: a misspelt block kind beside a field the block would take
notes: The E-SCHEMA-007 note used to say `modle` and `input` are not fields any block accepts -- false for `input`, the model block's main field, and the opposite of what the `help:` under it implies. `block_fields_by_kind` tells the two apart: `modle` is unknown, `input` is a field of `model` blocks.
